settings.heading: Wholesale Partnerships
settings.intro: We partner with select retailers who share our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and mindful living. If you're interested in carrying Aura & Oak in your store, we'd love to hear from you.
settings.benefit_text_1: Wholesale pricing starts at 50% off retail, with volume discounts available for larger orders.
settings.benefit_text_2: Our minimum opening order is $500. Reorders have a $250 minimum.
settings.benefit_text_3: Orders ship within 3-5 business days. We offer flat-rate shipping and free shipping on orders over $1,000.
settings.benefit_text_4: We provide product photography, display materials, and marketing assets to help you sell our products.
settings.cta_text: Email us at wholesale@auraandoak.com with your store information and we'll send you our wholesale catalog and application.
